project: Conan — v4.4: HUD/UX polish (active-tab binding, session header, MCP tab, editable Settings, Pulse fixes, Claude Radio)
description: v4.4 continues the Tauri terminal-wrapper's HUD/UX work: capture Claude Code's version from the SessionStart hook and add an editable Claude-config write route (backend foundations); bind the session-scoped HUD widgets to the ACTIVE terminal tab; a run of UI items — a slimmer bottom status bar (drop the gateway chip, flex cwd-left/branch-right, VS Code-style `*` dirty marker), Pulse-chart dark-mode legibility fixes, a user-facing Context 'Auto' toggle, a HUD MCP tab (servers + status), a fixed Claude-banner-style session header atop each terminal (logo placeholder + Conan & Claude Code versions + model/context + cwd), an editable tabbed (Status/Config) Settings dialog, and a Claude Radio play/pause bottom toolbar that streams a YouTube live stream. Backend/schema before UI; build stays green at every story. Source: docs/v4.4-backlog.md. Decisions (2026-05-27): show BOTH versions in the header (Conan + Claude Code); status bar uses a bare `*` for dirty (no count); MCP tab ships the flat name+status list first (tool-counts/grouping is a follow-up); Radio is its own app-wide bottom strip below the terminal+HUD row, default paused.

userStories.title: Capture Claude Code's version from the SessionStart hook
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want Conan to know which Claude Code version a session is running, so the session header can display it.
acceptanceCriteria: The session table gains a nullable `claude_version` column (idempotent init, no crash on existing DBs)
The events ingestion route (POST /api/claude/events) persists `payload.version` from the SessionStart hook onto the session row when present, leaving it null otherwise (never fabricated)
GET /api/claude/sessions and the per-session widgets payload expose the captured `claude_version` (null when unknown)
scripts/hooks/send-event.mjs forwards the SessionStart payload's `version` field unchanged (no transformation)
A unit/integration check covers parsing/persisting the version from a SessionStart payload and the null fallback
npm test passes all suites
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend/schema foundation for the session header (US-008). Anchors: events route in src/gateway/index.ts, session table in src/db/, parse in src/widgets/index.ts, scripts/hooks/send-event.mjs. SessionStart's payload carries `version`; only persist when present.

userStories.title: Editable Claude-config write route + editable-key schema
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want a safe backend path to change Claude Code config values, so the Settings dialog can become editable.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend the config module (src/config/index.ts) so each editable key in SETTINGS_KEYS/GLOBAL_KEYS carries type metadata: kind ('boolean' | 'enum' | 'string' | 'number') and, for enums, the allowed values (e.g. theme, editorMode) extracted from the claude binary where applicable (not hand-guessed)

Add POST /api/claude/config (token-gated) that writes a single key via read-modify-write, preserving every other key in the target file (~/.claude/settings.json or ~/.claude.json) byte-for-byte except the changed value
The route rejects unknown keys and type-mismatched values with a 4xx and a clear error; it never writes a key not in the editable schema
GET /api/claude/config returns the value + type metadata so the UI can render the right control
A unit/integration test writes a key and asserts only that key changed (all other keys/permissions/hooks/mcp preserved), plus the reject paths
npm test passes all suites
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Backend foundation for editable Settings (US-010). Read-modify-write preserving all other keys is the proven-safe pattern (v4.3 theme write). Anchors: readClaudeConfig + SETTINGS_KEYS/GLOBAL_KEYS in src/config/index.ts, GET /api/claude/config in src/gateway/index.ts.

userStories.title: Bind the session-scoped HUD widgets to the ACTIVE terminal tab
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want the Context/Plan/Skills widgets to describe the terminal tab I'm looking at, so opening a new terminal doesn't keep showing the previous session's data.
acceptanceCriteria: TerminalPane surfaces its active terminal id upward via a callback prop, covering tab switch, new terminal, and close (the active tid always reflects the visible terminal)
App tracks the active tid and derives the active session from the terminal correlated to THAT tid (via useTerminals tid→sessionId), instead of `matched.find(running) ?? matched[0]`
The Context, Plan, and Skills widgets + the notification visibleSessionId all repoint to the active tab's session
Switching terminal tabs updates the HUD widgets to the newly active tab's session; a freshly opened tab shows an empty/uncorrelated state until its pty correlates (not the prior tab's data)
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (open a 2nd terminal → HUD widgets repoint; switch back → they follow)
userStories.notes: Foundation for the per-session header (US-008) and MCP tab (US-007) to track the active tab. Anchors: correlatedSession/activeSession in ui/src/App.tsx, activeTid in ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx, useTerminals. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Context tab: user-facing 'Auto' context-tracking toggle (inline with manual refresh)
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want to turn the adaptive /context auto-refresh on or off from the Context tab, so I control the observer-effect tradeoff instead of an env var.
acceptanceCriteria: A toggle sits inline with the existing ↻ /context manual refresh button in the Context widget header (one control group)
Auto ON enables the adaptive auto-inject path (the v3 delta-triggered cadence, not every turn); Auto OFF stops auto-injects while the manual refresh button still works on click

The toggle drives a runtime-settable flag that gates the existing autoRefreshContextOnStop path (lifting the CONAN_CONTEXT_AUTOREFRESH env gate to a UI-controlled setting), defaulting from the env var; the preference persists and is reflected on reload
The toggle's label/tooltip notes that Auto spends context to measure context (honest cost), consistent with the live·from /context framing
Typecheck passes
cd ui && npm run build is clean
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (toggle + button render inline; ON re-enables auto-refresh, OFF stops auto-injects while manual refresh still works), light + dark
userStories.notes: Surfaces an existing capability. Anchors: autoRefreshContextOnStop + CONAN_CONTEXT_AUTOREFRESH in src/terminal/index.ts (fired from the Stop branch in src/gateway/index.ts); manual button + ContextWidget in ui/src/components/Widgets.tsx; route POST /api/claude/sessions/:id/context/refresh. Decide global vs per-session scope at implementation; a small runtime flag endpoint is acceptable. Suggested skills: automate-browser.

userStories.title: Fixed Claude-banner-style session header atop each terminal
userStories.description: As a Conan user, I want a pinned header on the terminal pane showing what's running (logo, versions, model/context, cwd), so I see it without scrolling the terminal back to Claude's banner.
acceptanceCriteria: A new SessionHeader.tsx renders three lines mirroring Claude's banner: (1) a logo placeholder (text/lucide, artwork TBD) + product line showing BOTH versions, e.g. `Conan 0.1.0 · Claude Code v2.1.152` (Conan version from ABOUT/package.json; Claude version from the session's claude_version captured in US-001, shown as `—` when unknown); (2) model (context), e.g. `Opus 4.7 (1M context)` from WidgetData.liveContext.modelDisplay + windowTokens (falling back to context.model); (3) the session cwd (~-collapsed)
The header is mounted in TerminalPane above the terminal body (between the tab strip and the xterm surface), describing the ACTIVE terminal tab's session (US-003)
A graceful fallback renders when the tab is uncorrelated (logo + Conan version + cwd; model line muted, Claude version `—`) rather than a blank bar
Semantic tokens only; flush styling with a 1px bottom border; the terminal body is unaffected (no layout shift / no pty teardown)
Typecheck passes

Anchors: ui/src/components/TerminalPane.tsx (above the terminal body), WidgetData.liveContext (ui/src/hooks/useWidgets.ts), Session.cwd/config.cwd, ABOUT in ui/src/lib/appMenu.ts. userStories.title: Claude Radio — app-wide bottom toolbar play/pause for the YouTube live stream

acceptanceCriteria: A new RadioBar.tsx hosts an offscreen (1×1 / visually hidden) YouTube IFrame Player for video id YmQ7jRgf4f0 (https://www.youtube.com/live/YmQ7jRgf4f0), controlled via the YouTube IFrame Player API (playVideo/pauseVideo)
